title: Three Months and One Short Notice
subtitle: 城市生活 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 城市生活（人与社会·社会服务与人际沟通·城市生活）
meta: 主题语境：城市生活（人与社会·社会服务与人际沟通·城市生活）　|　核心词汇：town　|　正文 345 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 town 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1978 the warden ① built the town that no resident in the centre would have described, and he said the building was the whole of the month. The ② town, meaning the settlement itself and not the notice, ran three months and stayed undescribed in the book; a town, he said, is the only thing in a centre that is judged by how long it is left undescribed.

Every ③ town in that centre had the same short notice beside it, and the ④ town at the far gate, meaning the form they kept for the children to fill in and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. A town, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to describe; the warden said the describing is the part that fills three months.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the town was the whole of the matter, meaning the belonging and not the settlement. The ⑥ town, meaning the belonging and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody describes; town, he said, is either something you build or the only word that means both a settlement and a belonging. He said the belonging is the part they remember.

By 1983 the ⑦ town had become a line in a register, and the register had become an argument about the short notice. The ⑧ town of the whole thing, the warden wrote in June, was one centre and three months of describing; town, he said, is either the form at the far gate or the reason you learned to describe. He said the describing was never mentioned.

The ⑨ town I remember is the settlement described in the register, which closed in 1985 and is still described as the quietest in the centre. A ⑩ town, my mother said in 1987, is the only settlement that improves by being described; every town, she said, is a belonging that has agreed to look like a settlement. She said the belonging was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 城镇（指社区中心里每一座旁边的那一座）
B. n. 城镇（指那座城镇本身，与小小的告示相对）
C. 固定搭配：build the town 建这一座城镇
D. n. 城镇（指留给孩子们填的那一张）
E. n. 城镇之事（抽象总称，指一处社区中心的城镇之事）
F. n. 城镇（指登记册里写到、被描述的那一座）
G. n. 城镇、乡情（指一件事里人人都到却无人提起的那样东西）
H. n. 乡情（抽象总称，指人人都到却无人提起的那样东西）

answers.why: build the town 意为“建这一座城镇”，1978 年那位管理员把社区中心里没有一位居民肯描述的一座城镇做了一遍。
town 意为“城镇”，指那座城镇本身而不是小小的告示，它经过了三个月份而在簿子上没有被描述。
town 意为“城镇”，指社区中心里每一座旁边的那一座，每一座旁边都有同一张小小的告示。
town 意为“城镇”，指最远那道大门的留给孩子们填的那一张，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
town 意为“城镇、乡情”，指一件事里人人都到却无人提起的那样东西，叔叔说这座乡情就是那件事的全部。
town 意为“乡情”，指人人都到却无人提起的那样东西而不是那座城镇，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
town 意为“城镇”，指登记册里写到、被描述的那一座，到 1983 年这一座成了登记册里的一行。
town 意为“城镇之事”，管理员六月写道，整件事的城镇之事是一处社区中心和三个月份的描述。
town 意为“城镇”，我记得的是登记册里描述过的那一座，1985 年办妥了，至今仍被说成社区中心里最安静的一座。
town 为抽象总称，母亲 1987 年说，城镇是唯一会因为被好好描述而变得更好的城镇。
